inputAnomalies.rawDefinition:
id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('goods_receipt_items_id_seq'::regclass),
  goods_receipt_id bigint NOT NULL,
  requested_item_id integer,
  item_name text NOT NULL,
  ordered_quantity numeric,
  received_quantity numeric NOT NULL,
  damaged_quantity numeric DEFAULT 0,
  short_quantity numeric DEFAULT 0,
  unit_price numeric,
  line_notes text,
  generic_item_id bigint,
  approved_product_id bigint,
  supplier_catalog_item_id bigint,
  purchase_order_item_id bigint,
  batch_number text,
  lot_number text,
  serial_number text,
  expiry_date date,
  warehouse_id bigint,
  stock_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'AVAILABLE'::text CHECK (stock_status = ANY (ARRAY['AVAILABLE'::text, 'QUARANTINE'::text, 'DAMAGED'::text, 'EXPIRED'::text, 'RECALLED'::text, 'BLOCKED'::text])),
  source_uom text,
  base_uom text,
  stock_item_id bigint,
  conversion_factor numeric CHECK (conversion_factor IS NULL OR conversion_factor > 0::numeric) NOT VALI),
  technical_inspection_required boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  technical_accepted_quantity numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (technical_accepted_quantity >= 0::numeric),
  technical_rejected_quantity numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (technical_rejected_quantity >= 0::numeric),
  CONSTRAINT goods_receipt_items_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT goods_receipt_items_goods_receipt_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (goods_receipt_id) REFERENCES public.goods_receipts(id),
  CONSTRAINT goods_receipt_items_requested_item_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (requested_item_id) REFERENCES public.requested_items(id),
  CONSTRAINT goods_receipt_items_generic_item_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (generic_item_id) REFERENCES public.generic_items(id),
  CONSTRAINT goods_receipt_items_approved_product_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (approved_product_id) REFERENCES public.approved_products(id),
  CONSTRAINT goods_receipt_items_supplier_catalog_item_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (supplier_catalog_item_id) REFERENCES public.supplier_catalog_items(id),
  CONSTRAINT goods_receipt_items_purchase_order_item_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (purchase_order_item_id) REFERENCES public.purchase_order_items(id),
  CONSTRAINT goods_receipt_items_warehouse_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (warehouse_id) REFERENCES public.warehouses(id),
  CONSTRAINT goods_receipt_items_stock_item_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (stock_item_id) REFERENCES public.stock_items(id)

inputAnomalies.definition: conversion_factor numeric CHECK (conversion_factor IS NULL OR conversion_factor > 0::numeric) NOT VALI)

inputAnomalies.rawDefinition:
id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('purchase_order_items_id_seq'::regclass),
  purchase_order_id bigint NOT NULL,
  requested_item_id integer,
  item_name text NOT NULL,
  quantity numeric NOT NULL,
  unit_price numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  received_quantity numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  invoiced_quantity numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  generic_item_id bigint,
  approved_product_id bigint,
  supplier_catalog_item_id bigint,
  request_id integer,
  request_item_id integer,
  award_id bigint,
  line_type text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NON_INVENTORY'::text CHECK (line_type = ANY (ARRAY['INVENTORY'::text, 'NON_INVENTORY'::text, 'SERVICE'::text, 'ASSET'::text, 'MEDICAL_DEVICE'::text])),
  price_source_type text,
  price_source_id bigint,
  source_uom_id integer,
  source_uom text,
  base_uom_id integer,
  base_uom text,
  conversion_factor numeric CHECK (conversion_factor IS NULL OR conversion_factor > 0::numeric) NOT VALI),
  CONSTRAINT purchase_order_items_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT purchase_order_items_requested_item_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (requested_item_id) REFERENCES public.requested_items(id),
  CONSTRAINT purchase_order_items_purchase_order_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (purchase_order_id) REFERENCES public.purchase_orders(id),
  CONSTRAINT purchase_order_items_generic_item_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (generic_item_id) REFERENCES public.generic_items(id),
  CONSTRAINT purchase_order_items_approved_product_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (approved_product_id) REFERENCES public.approved_products(id),
  CONSTRAINT purchase_order_items_supplier_catalog_item_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (supplier_catalog_item_id) REFERENCES public.supplier_catalog_items(id),
  CONSTRAINT purchase_order_items_request_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (request_id) REFERENCES public.requests(id),
  CONSTRAINT purchase_order_items_request_item_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (request_item_id) REFERENCES public.requested_items(id),
  CONSTRAINT purchase_order_items_award_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (award_id) REFERENCES public.procurement_awards(id),
  CONSTRAINT purchase_order_items_source_uom_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (source_uom_id) REFERENCES public.item_uom(id),
  CONSTRAINT purchase_order_items_base_uom_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (base_uom_id) REFERENCES public.item_uom(id)

              WHEN request_status = 'approved' AND fulfilled_item_count = 0 THEN 'Approved - not started'

        ), aged AS (
          SELECT

              WHEN active_seconds <= 604800 THEN '0-7 days'
              WHEN active_seconds <= 1209600 THEN '8-14 days'
              WHEN active_seconds <= 2592000 THEN '15-30 days'
              WHEN active_seconds <= 5184000 THEN '31-60 days'
              ELSE '60+ days'
            END AS bucket,
            CASE
              WHEN active_seconds <= 604800 THEN 1
              WHEN active_seconds <= 1209600 THEN 2
              WHEN active_seconds <= 2592000 THEN 3
              WHEN active_seconds <= 5184000 THEN 4
              ELSE 5
            END AS sort_order,
            actual_procured_cost
          FROM timed
        )
        SELECT bucket, COUNT(*) AS request_count, SUM(actual_procured_cost) AS procured_cost
        FROM aged
        GROUP BY bucket, sort_order

      END AS approval_duration_days,
      COALESCE(le.created_at, ri.procurement_updated_at, ri.marked_at) AS last_procurement_update,
      GREATEST(0, DATE_PART('day', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - r.created_at)::int) AS days_since_request,
      ln.note AS latest_follow_up_note,

        s.name AS section_name,

          SELECT JSON_AGG(DISTINCT JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('id', split_user.id, 'name', split_user.name, 'role', split_user.role))
          FROM public.requested_items split_ri
          JOIN users split_user ON split_user.id = split_ri.assigned_to
          WHERE split_ri.request_id = r.id

          NULLIF(TRIM(r.temporary_requester_name), ''),
          requester.name,
          CASE WHEN r.request_type = 'Maintenance' THEN initiating_technician.name END
        ) AS requester_name,
        CASE
          WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(r.temporary_requester_name), '') IS NOT NULL THEN 'Temporary Requester'
          WHEN requester.name IS NOT NULL THEN requester.role
          WHEN r.request_type = 'Maintenance' THEN initiating_technician.role
        END AS requester_role,
        ap.approval_level AS current_approval_level,
        au.role AS current_approver_role
      FROM requests r

      LEFT JOIN sections s ON r.section_id = s.id

      LEFT JOIN users requester ON r.requester_id = requester.id

        SELECT active_ap.*

        LIMIT 1

      OFFSET $${params.length + 2}

SELECT
         a.id AS approval_id,
         r.id AS request_id,
         r.request_type,
         r.justification,
         r.maintenance_ref_number,
         r.estimated_cost,
         ${effectiveRequestStatusSql('r')} AS status,
         r.is_urgent,
         a.status AS approval_status,
         a.comments AS approval_comments,
         CASE
           WHEN a.comments = 'Edit Approval' THEN TRUE
           ELSE FALSE
         END AS is_edit_approval,
         budget_snapshot.budget_envelope_id,
         budget_snapshot.allocated_amount AS budget_allocated_amount,
         budget_snapshot.available_amount AS budget_available_amount,
         budget_snapshot.currency AS budget_currency,
         COALESCE(budget_snapshot.available_amount < COALESCE(r.estimated_cost, 0), FALSE) AS budget_exceeded,
         a.approval_level,
         COALESCE((
           SELECT JSON_AGG(
             JSON_BUILD_OBJECT(
               'approval_id', prior.id,
               'approval_level', prior.approval_level,
               'approver_id', prior.approver_id,
               'approver_name', prior_user.name,
               'approver_role', prior_user.role,
               'approved_at', prior.approved_at
             )
             ORDER BY prior.approval_level ASC, prior.approved_at ASC NULLS LAST, prior.id ASC
           )
           FROM approvals prior
           JOIN users prior_user ON prior.approver_id = prior_user.id
           WHERE prior.request_id = r.id
             AND prior.status = 'Approved'
             AND prior.approval_level < a.approval_level
         ), '[]'::json) AS previous_approvers,
         r.project_id,
         p.name AS project_name,
         r.department_id,
         r.section_id,
         d.name AS department_name,
         s.name AS section_name,
         s.name AS section_name,
         COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(r.temporary_requester_name), ''), requester.name) AS requester_name,
         CASE
           WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(r.temporary_requester_name), '') IS NOT NULL THEN 'Temporary Requester'
           ELSE requester.role
         END AS requester_role
       FROM requests r
       LEFT JOIN projects p ON r.project_id = p.id
       LEFT JOIN departments d ON r.department_id = d.id
       LEFT JOIN sections s ON r.section_id = s.id
       LEFT JOIN users requester ON r.requester_id = requester.id
       LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
         SELECT
           be.id AS budget_envelope_id,
           be.allocated_amount,
           be.currency,
           be.allocated_amount - COALESCE((
             SELECT SUM(cl.amount)
             FROM commitment_ledger cl
             WHERE cl.budget_envelope_id = be.id
               AND cl.stage = 'actual'
           ), 0) AS available_amount
         FROM budget_envelopes be
         WHERE be.department_id = r.department_id
           AND r.institute_id=$2
           AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM departments budget_department WHERE budget_department.id=be.department_id AND budget_department.institute_id=r.institute_id)
           AND COALESCE(be.project_id::text, '') = COALESCE(r.project_id::text, '')
           AND be.fiscal_year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NOW())::integer
           AND be.currency = 'USD'
         LIMIT 1
       ) budget_snapshot ON TRUE
       JOIN approvals a ON r.id = a.request_id
       WHERE a.approver_id = $1
         AND a.is_active = true
         AND COALESCE(a.is_superseded, FALSE) = FALSE
         AND a.status IN ('Pending', 'On Hold')
         AND NOT ${completedRequestSql('r')}
         ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

WITH approval_timelines AS (
         SELECT
           ap.request_id,
           MIN(ap.updated_at) AS approval_started_at,
           MIN(ap.approved_at) FILTER (WHERE ap.approved_at IS NOT NULL) AS first_approval_at,
           MAX(ap.approved_at) FILTER (WHERE ap.status = 'Approved' AND ap.approved_at IS NOT NULL) AS final_approval_at,
           STRING_AGG(
             CONCAT(
               'Level ', COALESCE(ap.approval_level::text, '—'),
               ': ', COALESCE(NULLIF(ap.status, ''), 'Pending'),
               CASE WHEN approver.name IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(' by ', approver.name) ELSE '' END,
               CASE WHEN approver.role IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(' (', approver.role, ')') ELSE '' END,
               CASE WHEN ap.approved_at IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(' on ', TO_CHAR(ap.approved_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI')) ELSE '' END
             ),
             ' | ' ORDER BY ap.approval_level ASC NULLS LAST, ap.id ASC
           ) AS approval_timeline
         FROM approvals ap
         LEFT JOIN users approver ON approver.id = ap.approver_id
         GROUP BY ap.request_id
       )
       SELECT
         r.id,
         r.justification,
         r.maintenance_ref_number,
         ${effectiveRequestStatusSql('r')} AS status,
         r.created_at,
         CONCAT('Submitted on ', TO_CHAR(r.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), ' by ', COALESCE(r.temporary_requester_name, u.name, 'Unknown requester')) AS submission_timeline,
         r.project_id,
         r.is_urgent,
         p.name AS project_name,
         r.department_id,
         r.section_id,
         d.name AS department_name,
         s.name AS section_name,
         COALESCE(r.temporary_requester_name, u.name) AS requester_name,
         COALESCE(
           JSON_AGG(
             JSON_BUILD_OBJECT(
               'id', ri.id,
               'item_name', ri.item_name,
               'brand', ri.brand,
               'quantity', ri.quantity,
               'purchased_quantity', ri.purchased_quantity,
               'available_quantity', ri.available_quantity,
               'unit_cost', ri.unit_cost,
               'total_cost', ri.total_cost,
               'specs', ri.specs,
               'procurement_status', ri.procurement_status
             )
             ORDER BY ri.id
           ) FILTER (WHERE ri.id IS NOT NULL),
           '[]'::json
         ) AS items,
         (
           SELECT MIN(ap.approval_level)
           FROM approvals ap
           WHERE ap.request_id = r.id
             AND ap.status = 'Pending'
             AND ap.is_active = TRUE
             AND COALESCE(ap.is_superseded, FALSE) = FALSE
         ) AS current_approval_step,
         COALESCE((
           SELECT JSON_AGG(JSON_BUILD_OBJECT(
             'approval_id', ap.id,
             'approver_id', ap.approver_id,
             'approval_level', ap.approval_level,
             'activated_at', to_jsonb(ap)->>'activated_at',
             'active_waiting_seconds', ${activeSecondsSql('ap.request_id', "NULLIF(to_jsonb(ap)->>'activated_at','')", 'CURRENT_TIMESTAMP')},
             'approver_name', approver.name,
             'approver_role', approver.role
           ) ORDER BY ap.approval_level, ap.id)
           FROM approvals ap
           LEFT JOIN users approver ON approver.id = ap.approver_id
           WHERE ap.request_id = r.id
             AND ap.status = 'Pending'
             AND ap.is_active = TRUE
             AND COALESCE(ap.is_superseded, FALSE) = FALSE
         ), '[]'::json) AS current_pending_approvals,
         (
           SELECT u.name
           FROM approvals ap
           JOIN users u ON ap.approver_id = u.id
           WHERE ap.request_id = r.id
             AND ap.status = 'Pending'
             AND ap.is_active = true
             AND COALESCE(ap.is_superseded, FALSE) = FALSE
           ORDER BY ap.approval_level ASC
           LIMIT 1
         ) AS current_pending_approver_name,
         (
           SELECT u.role
           FROM approvals ap
           JOIN users u ON ap.approver_id = u.id
           WHERE ap.request_id = r.id
             AND ap.status = 'Pending'
             AND ap.is_active = true
             AND COALESCE(ap.is_superseded, FALSE) = FALSE
           ORDER BY ap.approval_level ASC
           LIMIT 1
         ) AS current_pending_approver_role,
         CASE
           WHEN r.status IN ('Approved', 'Completed') THEN (
             SELECT MAX(ap.approved_at)
             FROM approvals ap
             WHERE ap.request_id = r.id
               AND ap.status = 'Approved'
           )
           ELSE NULL
         END AS final_approval_date,
         CASE
           WHEN r.status IN ('Approved', 'Completed') THEN (
             SELECT u.name
             FROM approvals ap
             JOIN users u ON ap.approver_id = u.id
             WHERE ap.request_id = r.id
               AND ap.status = 'Approved'
             ORDER BY ap.approval_level DESC, ap.approved_at DESC NULLS LAST
             LIMIT 1
           )
           ELSE NULL
         END AS final_approver_name,
         at.approval_started_at,
         at.first_approval_at,
         at.final_approval_at,
         at.approval_timeline,
         CASE
           WHEN at.final_approval_at IS NULL THEN NULL
           ELSE ROUND(${activeDaysSql('r.id','r.created_at','at.final_approval_at')}, 2)
         END AS approval_duration_days,
         (
           SELECT COUNT(*)
           FROM attachments att
           WHERE att.request_id = r.id
         ) AS attachments_count
       FROM requests r
       LEFT JOIN projects p ON r.project_id = p.id
       LEFT JOIN departments d ON r.department_id = d.id
       LEFT JOIN sections s ON r.section_id = s.id
       LEFT JOIN users u ON r.requester_id = u.id
       LEFT JOIN approval_timelines at ON at.request_id = r.id
       LEFT JOIN public.requested_items ri ON ri.request_id = r.id
       WHERE r.request_type = 'Maintenance'
         ${viewerFilter}
       GROUP BY
         r.id,
         r.justification,
         r.maintenance_ref_number,
         r.status,
         r.created_at,
         r.project_id,
         r.is_urgent,
         p.name,
         r.department_id,
         r.section_id,
         d.name,
         s.name,
         u.name,
         r.temporary_requester_name,
         at.approval_started_at,
         at.first_approval_at,
         at.final_approval_at,
         at.approval_timeline
       ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

SELECT
         a.id AS approval_id,
         r.id AS request_id,
         r.justification,
         r.maintenance_ref_number,
         r.is_urgent,
         r.estimated_cost,
         budget_snapshot.budget_envelope_id,
         budget_snapshot.allocated_amount AS budget_allocated_amount,
         budget_snapshot.available_amount AS budget_available_amount,
         budget_snapshot.currency AS budget_currency,
         COALESCE(budget_snapshot.available_amount < COALESCE(r.estimated_cost, 0), FALSE) AS budget_exceeded,
         a.approval_level,
         COALESCE((
           SELECT JSON_AGG(
             JSON_BUILD_OBJECT(
               'approval_id', prior.id,
               'approval_level', prior.approval_level,
               'approver_id', prior.approver_id,
               'approver_name', prior_user.name,
               'approver_role', prior_user.role,
               'approved_at', prior.approved_at
             )
             ORDER BY prior.approval_level ASC, prior.approved_at ASC NULLS LAST, prior.id ASC
           )
           FROM approvals prior
           JOIN users prior_user ON prior.approver_id = prior_user.id
           WHERE prior.request_id = r.id
             AND prior.status = 'Approved'
             AND prior.approval_level < a.approval_level
         ), '[]'::json) AS previous_approvers,
         COALESCE(r.temporary_requester_name, u.name) AS requester_name,
         d.name AS department_name,
         s.name AS section_name,
         r.created_at,
         r.project_id,
         p.name AS project_name,
         COALESCE(
           JSON_AGG(
             JSON_BUILD_OBJECT(
               'id', ri.id,
               'item_name', ri.item_name,
               'brand', ri.brand,
               'quantity', ri.quantity,
               'available_quantity', ri.available_quantity,
               'unit_cost', ri.unit_cost,
               'total_cost', ri.total_cost,
               'specs', ri.specs,
               'approval_status', ri.approval_status,
               'approval_comments', ri.approval_comments,
               'approved_by', ri.approved_by,
               'approved_at', ri.approved_at
             )
             ORDER BY ri.id
           ) FILTER (WHERE ri.id IS NOT NULL),
           '[]'
         ) AS items
       FROM requests r
       JOIN users u ON r.requester_id = u.id
       JOIN departments d ON r.department_id = d.id
       LEFT JOIN sections s ON r.section_id = s.id
       JOIN approvals a ON a.request_id = r.id
       LEFT JOIN projects p ON r.project_id = p.id
       LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
         SELECT
           be.id AS budget_envelope_id,
           be.allocated_amount,
           be.currency,
           be.allocated_amount - COALESCE((
             SELECT SUM(cl.amount)
             FROM commitment_ledger cl
             WHERE cl.budget_envelope_id = be.id
               AND cl.stage = 'actual'
           ), 0) AS available_amount
         FROM budget_envelopes be
         WHERE be.department_id = r.department_id
           AND r.institute_id=$2
           AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM departments budget_department WHERE budget_department.id=be.department_id AND budget_department.institute_id=r.institute_id)
           AND COALESCE(be.project_id::text, '') = COALESCE(r.project_id::text, '')
           AND be.fiscal_year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NOW())::integer
           AND be.currency = 'USD'
         LIMIT 1
       ) budget_snapshot ON TRUE
       LEFT JOIN public.requested_items ri ON ri.request_id = r.id
       WHERE r.request_type = 'Maintenance'
         AND a.approver_id = $1
         AND a.status = 'Pending'
         AND a.is_active = true
         AND COALESCE(a.is_superseded, FALSE) = FALSE
         AND NOT ${completedRequestSql('r')}
       GROUP BY a.id, r.id, r.temporary_requester_name, u.name, d.name, s.name, p.name,
         budget_snapshot.budget_envelope_id,
         budget_snapshot.allocated_amount,
         budget_snapshot.available_amount,
         budget_snapshot.currency
       ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

SELECT r.*,${reporting.recordSql('r')} AS completion,${effectiveRequestStatusSql('r')} AS status,r.status AS stored_status, p.name AS project_name,

           )::int AS completed_item_count,

WITH
    pos AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT p.* FROM purchase_orders p WHERE p.contract_id=$1 AND ${scope.predicate("purchaseOrder", "p", "$2")}),
    invoices AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT i.* FROM supplier_invoices i JOIN pos p ON p.id=i.purchase_order_id
      WHERE i.contract_id=$1 AND ${scope.predicate("invoice", "i", "$2")}),
    active_invoices AS (SELECT * FROM invoices WHERE UPPER(status) NOT IN ('CANCELLED','VOIDED','DECLINED','SUPERSEDED','REPLACED')),
    payables AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT a.* FROM ap_payables a JOIN active_invoices i ON i.id=a.supplier_invoice_id
      JOIN ap_vouchers v ON v.id=a.ap_voucher_id AND v.supplier_invoice_id=i.id AND lower(v.voucher_status)='posted'
      WHERE a.request_id=i.request_id AND a.supplier_id=i.supplier_id AND UPPER(a.currency)=UPPER(i.currency)
      AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM finance_postings f WHERE f.ap_voucher_id=v.id AND f.supplier_invoice_id=i.id AND f.request_id=i.request_id AND lower(f.posting_status)='posted')),
    allocations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT a.*,p.id payment_id,p.payment_reference,p.payment_status,p.currency,p.paid_at,p.amount_paid FROM payment_allocations a
      JOIN payables ap ON ap.id=a.ap_payable_id JOIN payment_records p ON p.id=a.payment_record_id
      WHERE p.supplier_invoice_id=ap.supplier_invoice_id AND p.ap_voucher_id=ap.ap_voucher_id AND p.request_id=ap.request_id
        AND UPPER(p.currency)=UPPER(ap.currency) AND lower(p.payment_status)='paid' AND p.reversal_of_payment_id IS NULL)
    SELECT
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_orders WHERE contract_id=$1)<>(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pos) OR
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM supplier_invoices WHERE contract_id=$1)<>(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoices) AS source_conflict,
      EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM payment_records p JOIN invoices i ON i.id=p.supplier_invoice_id WHERE p.reversal_of_payment_id IS NOT NULL OR
        (lower(p.payment_status)='paid' AND (UPPER(p.currency) IS DISTINCT FROM UPPER(i.currency) OR p.amount_paid IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT SUM(a.amount) FROM allocations a WHERE a.payment_id=p.id)))) OR
      EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM payables ap WHERE ap.payable_status NOT IN ('OPEN','PARTIALLY_PAID','PAID')) OR
      EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM allocations a WHERE a.amount<=0) OR
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ap_payables a JOIN invoices i ON i.id=a.supplier_invoice_id)<>(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payables) AS unsupported_reversal,
      EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM payables ap JOIN invoices i ON i.id=ap.supplier_invoice_id JOIN ap_vouchers v ON v.id=ap.ap_voucher_id WHERE
        ap.invoice_total IS DISTINCT FROM i.total_amount OR v.total_amount IS DISTINCT FROM i.total_amount OR
        ap.open_balance IS DISTINCT FROM ap.invoice_total-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.amount) FROM allocations a WHERE a.ap_payable_id=ap.id),0) OR
        EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM finance_postings f WHERE f.ap_voucher_id=v.id AND lower(f.posting_status)='posted' AND f.liability_recognized_amount IS DISTINCT FROM ap.invoice_total)) AS balance_conflict,

      (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount),0)::text FROM pos WHERE status IN ${finance.RESERVED}) approved_po_commitments,
      (SELECT COALESCE(SUM((${receipt.accepted("gri")})*pi.unit_price),0)::text FROM goods_receipt_items gri JOIN goods_receipts gr ON gr.id=gri.goods_receipt_id JOIN pos p ON p.id=gr.purchase_order_id JOIN purchase_order_items pi ON pi.id=gri.purchase_order_item_id AND pi.purchase_order_id=p.id) received_value,
      (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount),0)::text FROM active_invoices) invoiced_value,
      (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(invoice_total),0)::text FROM payables) posted_payable,
      (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0)::text FROM allocations) paid_amount,
      (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ap.invoice_total-COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.amount) FROM allocations a WHERE a.ap_payable_id=ap.id),0)),0)::text FROM payables ap) outstanding_ap_balance,
      (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id::text,'number',po_number,'status',status,'amount',total_amount::text) ORDER BY id),'[]') FROM pos) purchase_orders,
      (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id::text,'number',invoice_number,'status',status,'amount',total_amount::text) ORDER BY id),'[]') FROM invoices) invoices,
      (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id::text,'invoice_id',supplier_invoice_id::text,'status',payable_status,'amount',invoice_total::text) ORDER BY id),'[]') FROM payables) payables,
      (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('allocation_id',id::text,'payment_id',payment_id::text,'payable_id',ap_payable_id::text,'amount',amount::text,'reference',payment_reference) ORDER BY id),'[]') FROM allocations) allocations

WITH active_cases AS (
  SELECT pc.id,pc.request_id,pc.institute_id,pc.department_id,d.department_rank AS legacy_rank
  FROM procurement_cases pc JOIN procurement_priority_profiles p ON p.procurement_case_id=pc.id ${priorityCaseJoins}
  LEFT JOIN department_priority_rankings d ON d.procurement_case_id=pc.id AND d.valid_until IS NULL
  WHERE ${activePriorityCaseSql} AND ${departmentApprovedRequestSql}
), request_positions AS (
  SELECT c.request_id,c.institute_id,c.department_id,COALESCE(q.department_rank,min(c.legacy_rank)) AS saved_rank
  FROM active_cases c LEFT JOIN request_priority_rankings q ON q.request_id=c.request_id
    AND q.institute_id=c.institute_id AND q.department_id=c.department_id
  GROUP BY c.request_id,c.institute_id,c.department_id,q.department_rank
), projected AS (
  SELECT request_id,CASE WHEN saved_rank IS NOT NULL THEN
    row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY institute_id,department_id ORDER BY saved_rank NULLS LAST,request_id)::int END AS department_rank,
    count(*) OVER(PARTITION BY institute_id,department_id)::int AS department_rank_total
  FROM request_positions
)

SELECT 'PRE_PROCUREMENT'::text AS type,t.id,t.request_id,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(r.maintenance_ref_number,''),'PR-'||r.id) AS reference,
      (SELECT string_agg(p->'snapshot'->>'item_name',', ' ORDER BY p->>'item_id') FROM jsonb_array_elements(t.item_packets) p) AS item_name,
      CASE WHEN t.status<>'IN_REVIEW' THEN 'COMPLETED' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM preprocurement_technical_review_assignments held WHERE held.review_id=t.id AND held.status IN ('CONDITIONAL','CLARIFICATION')) THEN 'ON_HOLD' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM preprocurement_technical_review_assignments progress WHERE progress.review_id=t.id AND progress.status<>'PENDING') THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' ELSE 'PENDING' END AS status,
      t.status AS decision,t.created_at,t.requesting_department_id AS department_id,d.name AS requesting_department,
      (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT ad.name,', ' ORDER BY ad.name) FROM preprocurement_technical_review_assignments a JOIN departments ad ON ad.id=a.department_id WHERE a.review_id=t.id) AS assigned_department,
      (SELECT jsonb_agg(DISTINCT a.department_id) FROM preprocurement_technical_review_assignments a WHERE a.review_id=t.id) AS assigned_department_ids,
      t.status='IN_REVIEW' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM preprocurement_technical_review_assignments own WHERE own.review_id=t.id AND own.reviewer_id=$2 AND own.status IN ('PENDING','IN_PROGRESS')) OR ($3 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM preprocurement_technical_review_assignments waiting WHERE waiting.review_id=t.id AND waiting.status<>'APPROVED') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM preprocurement_technical_review_assignments self WHERE self.review_id=t.id AND self.reviewer_id=$2))) AS awaiting_me
      FROM preprocurement_technical_reviews t JOIN requests r ON r.id=t.request_id AND r.institute_id=t.institute_id JOIN departments d ON d.id=t.requesting_department_id AND d.institute_id=t.institute_id
      WHERE t.institute_id=$1 AND ($3 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM preprocurement_technical_review_assignments own JOIN users u ON u.id=own.reviewer_id WHERE own.review_id=t.id AND own.reviewer_id=$2 AND u.is_active IS TRUE AND u.institute_id=$1 AND ${reviewerScope("u", "own.department_id", "$1")}))

SELECT 'PRE_PROCUREMENT'::text AS type,t.id,t.request_id,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(r.maintenance_ref_number,''),'PR-'||r.id) AS reference,
      (SELECT string_agg(p->'snapshot'->>'item_name',', ' ORDER BY p->>'item_id') FROM jsonb_array_elements(t.item_packets) p) AS item_name,
      CASE WHEN t.status<>'IN_REVIEW' THEN 'COMPLETED' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM preprocurement_technical_review_assignments held WHERE held.review_id=t.id AND held.status IN ('CONDITIONAL','CLARIFICATION')) THEN 'ON_HOLD' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM preprocurement_technical_review_assignments progress WHERE progress.review_id=t.id AND progress.status<>'PENDING') THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' ELSE 'PENDING' END AS status,
      t.status AS decision,t.created_at,t.requesting_department_id AS department_id,d.name AS requesting_department,
      (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT ad.name,', ' ORDER BY ad.name) FROM preprocurement_technical_review_assignments a JOIN departments ad ON ad.id=a.department_id WHERE a.review_id=t.id) AS assigned_department,
      (SELECT jsonb_agg(DISTINCT a.department_id) FROM preprocurement_technical_review_assignments a WHERE a.review_id=t.id) AS assigned_department_ids,
      t.status='IN_REVIEW' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM preprocurement_technical_review_assignments own WHERE own.review_id=t.id AND own.reviewer_id=$2 AND own.status IN ('PENDING','IN_PROGRESS')) OR ($3 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM preprocurement_technical_review_assignments waiting WHERE waiting.review_id=t.id AND waiting.status<>'APPROVED') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM preprocurement_technical_review_assignments self WHERE self.review_id=t.id AND self.reviewer_id=$2))) AS awaiting_me
      FROM preprocurement_technical_reviews t JOIN requests r ON r.id=t.request_id AND r.institute_id=t.institute_id JOIN departments d ON d.id=t.requesting_department_id AND d.institute_id=t.institute_id
      WHERE t.institute_id=$1 AND ($3 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM preprocurement_technical_review_assignments own JOIN users u ON u.id=own.reviewer_id WHERE own.review_id=t.id AND own.reviewer_id=$2 AND u.is_active IS TRUE AND u.institute_id=$1 AND ${reviewerScope("u", "own.department_id", "$1")}))

SELECT 'LEGACY_INSPECTION'::text AS type,i.id,i.request_id,
      CASE WHEN i.request_id IS NULL THEN 'TI-'||i.id ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(r.maintenance_ref_number,''),'PR-'||r.id) END AS reference,
      i.item_name,CASE WHEN lower(COALESCE(i.acceptance_status,'pending')) IN ('passed','failed') THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE 'PENDING' END AS status,
      COALESCE(i.acceptance_status,'pending') AS decision,i.created_at,r.department_id,d.name AS requesting_department,
      'Historical record — no task assignment'::text AS assigned_department,'[]'::jsonb AS assigned_department_ids,false AS awaiting_me
      FROM technical_inspections i LEFT JOIN requests r ON r.id=i.request_id LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.id=r.department_id LEFT JOIN users creator ON creator.id=i.created_by
      WHERE (i.request_id IS NOT NULL AND r.institute_id=$1) OR (i.request_id IS NULL AND creator.institute_id=$1)

SELECT 'DELIVERY_INSPECTION'::text AS type,t.id,t.request_id,gr.receipt_number AS reference,gri.item_name,
       CASE WHEN t.status='CLOSED' THEN 'COMPLETED' WHEN t.status IN ('IN_PROGRESS','DECIDED') THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' ELSE t.status END AS status,
       CASE WHEN t.status='DECIDED' THEN 'Awaiting receiving disposition' WHEN t.status='CLOSED' AND gri.technical_rejected_quantity>0 AND gri.technical_accepted_quantity>0 THEN 'PARTIALLY_ACCEPTED' WHEN t.status='CLOSED' AND gri.technical_rejected_quantity>0 THEN 'REJECTED' ELSE COALESCE(t.pending_disposition->>'decision',t.status) END AS decision,t.created_at,t.department_id,d.name AS requesting_department,
       (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT ad.name,', ' ORDER BY ad.name) FROM delivery_inspection_assignments a JOIN departments ad ON ad.id=a.department_id WHERE a.task_id=t.id) AS assigned_department,
       (SELECT jsonb_agg(DISTINCT a.department_id) FROM delivery_inspection_assignments a WHERE a.task_id=t.id) AS assigned_department_ids,
       ((t.status IN ('PENDING','IN_PROGRESS') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM delivery_inspection_assignments a WHERE a.task_id=t.id AND a.reviewer_id=$2 AND a.opinion IS NULL)) OR (t.status='DECIDED' AND ${receiving}) OR (t.status IN ('PENDING','IN_PROGRESS') AND $3 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM delivery_inspection_assignments a WHERE a.task_id=t.id AND (a.opinion IS NULL OR a.reviewer_id=$2)))) AS awaiting_me
       FROM delivery_inspection_tasks t JOIN goods_receipt_items gri ON gri.id=t.receipt_item_id JOIN goods_receipts gr ON gr.id=gri.goods_receipt_id JOIN departments d ON d.id=t.department_id
       WHERE t.institute_id=$1 AND ($3 OR ${receiving} OR t.created_by=$2 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM delivery_inspection_assignments a JOIN users u ON u.id=a.reviewer_id WHERE a.task_id=t.id AND a.reviewer_id=$2 AND u.is_active AND u.institute_id=$1 AND ${reviewerScope("u", "a.department_id", "$1")}))

SELECT 'DELIVERY_INSPECTION'::text AS type,t.id,t.request_id,gr.receipt_number AS reference,gri.item_name,
       CASE WHEN t.status='CLOSED' THEN 'COMPLETED' WHEN t.status IN ('IN_PROGRESS','DECIDED') THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' ELSE t.status END AS status,
       CASE WHEN t.status='DECIDED' THEN 'Awaiting receiving disposition' WHEN t.status='CLOSED' AND gri.technical_rejected_quantity>0 AND gri.technical_accepted_quantity>0 THEN 'PARTIALLY_ACCEPTED' WHEN t.status='CLOSED' AND gri.technical_rejected_quantity>0 THEN 'REJECTED' ELSE COALESCE(t.pending_disposition->>'decision',t.status) END AS decision,t.created_at,t.department_id,d.name AS requesting_department,
       (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT ad.name,', ' ORDER BY ad.name) FROM delivery_inspection_assignments a JOIN departments ad ON ad.id=a.department_id WHERE a.task_id=t.id) AS assigned_department,
       (SELECT jsonb_agg(DISTINCT a.department_id) FROM delivery_inspection_assignments a WHERE a.task_id=t.id) AS assigned_department_ids,
       ((t.status IN ('PENDING','IN_PROGRESS') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM delivery_inspection_assignments a WHERE a.task_id=t.id AND a.reviewer_id=$2 AND a.opinion IS NULL)) OR (t.status='DECIDED' AND ${receiving}) OR (t.status IN ('PENDING','IN_PROGRESS') AND $3 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM delivery_inspection_assignments a WHERE a.task_id=t.id AND (a.opinion IS NULL OR a.reviewer_id=$2)))) AS awaiting_me
       FROM delivery_inspection_tasks t JOIN goods_receipt_items gri ON gri.id=t.receipt_item_id JOIN goods_receipts gr ON gr.id=gri.goods_receipt_id JOIN departments d ON d.id=t.department_id
       WHERE t.institute_id=$1 AND ($3 OR ${receiving} OR t.created_by=$2 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM delivery_inspection_assignments a JOIN users u ON u.id=a.reviewer_id WHERE a.task_id=t.id AND a.reviewer_id=$2 AND u.is_active AND u.institute_id=$1 AND ${reviewerScope("u", "a.department_id", "$1")}))

WITH actor_context AS (SELECT $1::integer AS institute_id,$2::integer AS user_id,$3::boolean AS manager), tasks AS (${sources.join(" UNION ALL ")}),
      filtered AS (SELECT * FROM tasks ${filters.length ? `WHERE ${filters.join(" AND ")}` : ""}),
      page_rows AS (SELECT * FROM filtered ORDER BY created_at DESC,type,id DESC LIMIT 25 OFFSET $${params.length})
      SELECT COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) ORDER BY p.created_at DESC,p.type,p.id DESC) FROM page_rows p),'[]'::jsonb) AS rows,
      (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM filtered) AS total,
      (SELECT jsonb_build_object('awaiting_my_review',count(*) FILTER(WHERE awaiting_me),'in_progress',count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='IN_PROGRESS'),'on_hold',count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='ON_HOLD'),'completed',count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='COMPLETED')) FROM filtered) AS summary,
      COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',d.id,'name',d.name) ORDER BY d.name) FROM departments d WHERE d.institute_id=$1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tasks t WHERE t.assigned_department_ids @> jsonb_build_array(d.id))),'[]'::jsonb) AS departments
